ns2:section.sectionText: Comparative Constitutional Design This course examines the design and implementation of national constitutions and addresses the following questions. What are the basic elements of constitutions? How do these elements differ across time, across region, and across regime type? What is the process by which states draft and implement constitutions? What are the critical debates that arise during constitutional deliberations? What models, theories, and writings have influenced the framers of constitutions? Readings include historical sources regarding important cases of constitutional design as well as more thematic and cross-national sources on the characteristics, causes, and consequences of constitutions.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
